flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/repccs/notice_creation/core/helpers/SpecialVehUtils (classification from number pattern only), agencies/lta/download/helpers/LtaProcessingOrchestrator, datahiveuenfin/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItem* are only log placeholders). ocmsadminui src/pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx (empty), utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, utils/data/LinkData.tsx (Work Item menu commented out). There is no work item table or entity in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi.
note: There is no code for a work item to the OIC dashboard for special vehicle exceptions. There is no comparison of the vehicle owner with an entity (no entity table), no work item creation (only placeholder methods that write a log for other DataHive cases), and the ocmsadminui Dashboard only contains an empty div; the Work Item menu is commented out. The only work item in the UI is a constant for UPL Endorsement, not related. The ocms_work_item entity is only mentioned in comments.
recommendation: Do not claim. There is no code evidence for exception detection, work item creation, or display on the OIC dashboard.

steps.step: OCMS checks the full conditions and finds special vehicle notices that do not meet them, for example the owner differs from the entity in the parameter table
steps.detail: D and I classification comes only from the vehicle number pattern (SpecialVehUtils.java:114-131). There is no entity table, no comparison of the owner ID or name with an entity, and no branch for the not fully met case. The LTA diplomatic flag only sets type D (LtaProcessingOrchestrator.java:247-250). A grep for work item, entity and embassy in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi did not find this logic.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item containing the notice number, vehicle number and name
steps.detail: The only methods named work item are placeholders that only write a log and skip creation (DataHiveUenFinService.java:2914-2924, 3517-3519: feature not ready); table ocms_work_item only appears in comments (:2907-2912) and there is no work item entity or repository in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi. Those methods are also for FIN PR/SC and death cases, not special vehicles.

steps.step: The work item is routed to the OIC dashboard so the OIC can follow up the exception
steps.detail: The Dashboard only contains an empty div with no API call (Dashboard.tsx:19-31) and is the index route (App.tsx:79). The Work Item menu is commented out (LinkData.tsx:398) and WorkItem.ts only holds the path /work-item with no route in App.tsx. There is no ocmsadminapi endpoint to list work items or allocate them to an OIC.
